name: vibrissa
description: Ultra-light JSON-driven MCP integration test runner

scripts.build: tsup src/cli.ts src/index.ts --format esm --target node20 --dts --clean --sourcemap --external fast-glob
scripts.dev: tsup src/cli.ts src/index.ts --format esm --target node20 --dts --watch --sourcemap --external fast-glob
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.e2e: npm run build && node bin/vib-test.js --config tests/fixtures/echo-server/vibrissa.json
scripts.e2e:demo: npm run build && node bin/vib-test.js --config tests/fixtures/echo-server/vibrissa.json --cases "tests/fixtures/echo-server/cases/**/*.json"

author: Jordan Moak
